test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is "**attacked**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The first clause of the given sentence is in the **past continuous** tense followed by **a past simple tense **after the conjunction 'that'. 
 
• We use present continuous to narrate a story or describe an event that was happening in the past.
 
• In the first clause, we see that the present participle form of the verb(-ing form) is used. The verb is "fighting".
 
• In the second clause, we need to use the past participle form of the verb (-ed form).
 
• The correct verb form in the second clause will be "**attacked**"

Hence, the correct sentence is **option 1.**

The complete passage is: A woman has been called a hero after fighting a mountain lion that *(1) attacked* her five-year-old son. She dragged her little *(2) boy* away from the big cat and beat it with *(3) her* fists in her garden. The boy had bites* (4) and* cuts to his head and body. He is now in a local* (5) hospital*. He is expected to make a full recovery.
